recordings.title: Shashvata
recordings.significance: Grounds volatile emotions in permanent reality that never changes across time.

recordings.title: Shauri (Venkateswara)
recordings.significance: Instills brave resolve and unwavering endurance during adversity.

recordings.title: Shriman (Venkateswara)
recordings.significance: Endows personal character with quiet dignity, noble poise, and good reputation.

recordings.title: Sri Venkateswara
recordings.significance: Incinerates mountains of accumulated sins ('Vem') and grants supreme liberation ('Kata').

recordings.title: Srihari
recordings.significance: Sweeps away sorrow, depressing memories, and heavy mental fatigue in an instant.

recordings.title: Srinivasa
recordings.significance: Anchors the eternal presence of Mahalakshmi, bestowing auspicious wealth and spiritual fulfillment.

recordings.title: Srivatsavakshas
recordings.significance: Bears the auspicious sign of Lakshmi upon the chest, blessing seekers with lasting divine grace.

recordings.title: Trivikrama
recordings.significance: Overcomes worldly and mental boundaries, conquering obstacles across all three realms.

recordings.title: Vaikunthapati
recordings.significance: Removes existential anxiety and opens the pathway to the sorrowless eternal realm.

recordings.title: Vanamali
recordings.significance: Adorns character with harmonious natural balance, beauty, and unconditional love.

recordings.title: Varaprada
recordings.significance: Generously bestows spiritual attainments, protective boons, and timely assistance.

recordings.title: Vishnu
recordings.significance: Pervades every atom of manifest reality, providing unseen biological and spiritual support.

recordings.title: Yadavendra
recordings.significance: Strengthens fair governance, community loyalty, and protective leadership.

recordings.title: Yajnabhokta
recordings.significance: Receives and validates every genuine, selfless effort made by the seeker.

recordings.title: Yajnarupa
recordings.significance: Transforms mundane daily labor into a conscious, sacred cosmic offering.

recordings.title: Yogihritpadmamandira
recordings.significance: Dwells peacefully within the heart lotus of focused meditators during quiet sadhana.

recordings.title: Abhrarupa Bhairava
recordings.significance: Contemplates the Lord who is as free and vast as the sky.
recordings.form:
Abhrarupa means 'cloud-formed' - a form like drifting cloud. Signature: a body of drifting white and grey cloud above mountain valleys, sunlight breaking through.
Significance: Contemplates the Lord who is as free and vast as the sky.

recordings.title: Antaka Bhairava
recordings.significance: Remembers that every ending is held in the Lord's hands.
recordings.form:
Antaka means 'the one who brings to an end'. Signature: the last light of evening over a still river, an oil lamp burning steadily.
Significance: Remembers that every ending is held in the Lord's hands.

recordings.title: Ati Santushta Bhairava
recordings.significance: Offers simple devotion with the trust that sincerity is enough.
recordings.form:
Ati Santushta means 'the deeply pleased' - the Bhairava who is gladdened by the simplest sincere offering. Signature: a gentle smiling face, a clay lamp, flowers and a bowl of food at a village wayside shrine.
Significance: Offers simple devotion with the trust that sincerity is enough.

recordings.title: Bhayankara Bhairava
recordings.significance: Asks that fear be turned upon harm itself.
recordings.form:
Bhayankara means 'the fear-inspiring (to evil)'. Signature: a night guard of the town, his fierce presence keeping the streets safe.
Significance: Asks that fear be turned upon harm itself.

recordings.title: Bhishana Bhairava
recordings.significance: Asks for the strength that cannot be shaken.
recordings.form:
Bhishana means 'the formidable' - one of the eight great (Ashta) Bhairavas. Signature: a towering fierce form at the edge of a dark forest, protective and immovable.
Significance: Asks for the strength that cannot be shaken.

recordings.title: Bhishita Bhairava
recordings.significance: Asks that every harmful force be driven away.
recordings.form:
Bhishita means 'the terrifying (to wrongdoers)'. Signature: a stormy night, dark shapes of harm scattering before his trident.
Significance: Asks that every harmful force be driven away.

recordings.title: Bhukti Mukti Phala Prada Bhairava
recordings.mantra: Om Bhukti Mukti Phala Prada Bhairavaya Namah
recordings.significance: Prays for a good life and for liberation.
recordings.form:
Bhukti Mukti Phala Prada means 'giver of the fruits of worldly joy (bhukti) and liberation (mukti)'. Signature: one hand offering a harvest of grain and fruit, the other pointing to a path of light.
Significance: Prays for a good life and for liberation.

recordings.title: Bhumigarbha Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for the hidden strength that makes everything grow.
recordings.form:
Bhumigarbha means 'the womb of the earth' - the hidden source within the earth. Signature: a cave glowing with crystals and roots, seeds sprouting in dark soil.
Significance: Prays for the hidden strength that makes everything grow.

recordings.title: Bhuta Vetala Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for protection from unseen harm.
recordings.form:
Bhuta Vetala means 'lord of the spirits and vetalas' - the master whom every restless spirit obeys. Signature: commanding his host of ganas at a moonlit cremation ground, calm and in control (never gory).
Significance: Prays for protection from unseen harm.

recordings.title: Dakshinabhisthita Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for protection from the south and from untimely harm.
recordings.form:
Dakshinabhisthita means 'the one who stands facing the south'. Signature: facing the southern sky beside a South Indian temple tower at dusk.
Significance: Prays for protection from the south and from untimely harm.

recordings.title: Danda Karna Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for justice and protection from wrongdoing.
recordings.form:
Danda Karna joins 'danda', the staff of justice, and 'karna', the ear - the guardian who hears every wrong and holds the staff of dharma. Signature: holding a tall danda staff at a temple gate, attentive and still.
Significance: Prays for justice and protection from wrongdoing.

recordings.title: Dharapalana Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for the earth that feeds all beings.
recordings.form:
Dharapalana means 'the one who sustains the earth'. Signature: protecting the earth - furrowed fields, rivers and hills cradled under his care.
Significance: Prays for the earth that feeds all beings.

recordings.title: Gadadhara Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for steadiness and protection.
recordings.form:
Gadadhara means 'the bearer of the mace'. Signature: holding a heavy golden mace, steady and protective.
Significance: Prays for steadiness and protection.

recordings.title: Ghora Natha Bhairava
recordings.significance: Seeks the fierce grace that clears every obstacle.
recordings.form:
Ghora Natha means 'lord of the fierce'. Signature: seated beside a sacred fire at night, fierce and still.
Significance: Seeks the fierce grace that clears every obstacle.

recordings.title: Ishana Bhairava
recordings.significance: Bows to the sovereign Lord.
recordings.form:
Ishana means 'the ruler' - the name of Shiva's north-eastern face. Signature: a regal form at a north-east dawn, the sky turning gold.
Significance: Bows to the sovereign Lord.

recordings.title: Kalagni Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays that time's fire burns away the ego.
recordings.form:
Kalagni means 'the fire of Time'. Signature: embers and a great slow fire rising into a starry sky, Bhairava calm within it.
Significance: Prays that time's fire burns away the ego.

recordings.title: Kapala Bhairava
recordings.significance: Remembers humility and the giving-up of pride.
recordings.form:
Kapala means 'bearer of the skull-bowl' - one of the eight great (Ashta) Bhairavas, traditionally shown riding an elephant. Signature: holding the kapala bowl, a stately elephant beside him.
Significance: Remembers humility and the giving-up of pride.

recordings.title: Kapala Bhushana Bhairava
recordings.significance: Contemplates freedom from the fear of death.
recordings.form:
Kapala Bhushana means 'adorned with skull ornaments' - the fierce Lord's traditional ornaments. Signature: the ornaments shown as finely carved temple-art beads (never gory), deep blue night.
Significance: Contemplates freedom from the fear of death.

recordings.title: Karala Bhairava
recordings.significance: Asks for protection that frightens away harm.
recordings.form:
Karala means 'the formidable' - a fearsome face that turns evil away. Signature: a fierce fanged face lit by flames, yet a protective raised hand.
Significance: Asks for protection that frightens away harm.

recordings.title: Khechara Bhairava
recordings.significance: Remembers the Lord whose presence is not bound to any place.
recordings.form:
Khechara means 'the one who moves in the sky'. Signature: Bhairava amid clouds and stars, his dog companion beside him in the night sky.
Significance: Remembers the Lord whose presence is not bound to any place.

recordings.title: Kreeranna Bhairava
recordings.significance: Honours one of the sixty-four forms of Bhairava with the devotee's chant.
recordings.form:
Kreeranna is the name as chanted in this list of sixty-four; its meaning is not certain, so no meaning is claimed for it. Signature: Bhairava sounding the damaru in a festive night procession of lamps and drums.
Significance: Honours one of the sixty-four forms of Bhairava with the devotee's chant.

recordings.title: Kshetrapalaka Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for the protection of home, village and holy places.
recordings.form:
Kshetrapalaka means 'protector of the sacred ground' - Bhairava as the guardian of temples, villages and fields, whose shrine stands at the gate. Signature: standing guard at a temple gopuram and at a village boundary stone.
Significance: Prays for the protection of home, village and holy places.

recordings.title: Kula Bhairava
recordings.significance: Honours the unbroken line of devotion.
recordings.form:
Kula means 'the clan, the lineage of devotees'. Signature: generations of devotees - grandparents, parents, children - offering lamps at the same old shrine.
Significance: Honours the unbroken line of devotion.

recordings.title: Kulapala Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for the protection of family and lineage.
recordings.form:
Kulapala means 'protector of the family and lineage'. Signature: watching over a household shrine with oil lamps and family offerings.
Significance: Prays for the protection of family and lineage.

recordings.title: Lokapala Bhairava
recordings.significance: Asks for protection in every direction.
recordings.form:
Lokapala means 'guardian of the worlds'. Signature: watching over the eight directions from a high place, the horizon glowing all around.
Significance: Asks for protection in every direction.

recordings.title: Maha Raudra Bhairava
recordings.significance: Bows to the Lord's overwhelming power.
recordings.form:
Maha Raudra means 'the greatly fierce'. Signature: a tempest over the Himalayas, snow and thunder around him.
Significance: Bows to the Lord's overwhelming power.

recordings.title: Mahakala Bhairava
recordings.significance: Bows to the Lord before whom time itself bows.
recordings.form:
Mahakala means 'great Time' - Bhairava as the master of time itself. Signature: the turning wheel of time, night skies and the ancient temple city of Ujjain.
Significance: Bows to the Lord before whom time itself bows.

recordings.title: Manovega Bhairava
recordings.significance: Trusts that help comes swiftly when called sincerely.
recordings.form:
Manovega means 'swift as the mind' - the Lord who arrives at the speed of thought when called. Signature: streaking across valleys and rivers as a trail of light.
Significance: Trusts that help comes swiftly when called sincerely.

recordings.title: Mantra Nayaka Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for the power of sincere chanting.
recordings.form:
Mantra Nayaka means 'lord of the mantras'. Signature: devotees chanting with rudraksha malas, sound shown as rings of light (never written letters).
Significance: Prays for the power of sincere chanting.

recordings.title: Martanda Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for radiance, vigour and the light that ends inner darkness.
recordings.form:
Martanda means 'the sun-like, of the sun' - Bhairava blazing with solar radiance. Signature: a golden-orange sunrise halo, morning light on river ghats.
Significance: Prays for radiance, vigour and the light that ends inner darkness.

recordings.title: Meghanatha Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for timely rain and fruitful fields.
recordings.form:
Meghanatha means 'lord of the clouds'. Signature: towering monsoon clouds, rain sweeping over green rice fields, thunder over the hills.
Significance: Prays for timely rain and fruitful fields.

recordings.title: Mundana Prabhu Bhairava
recordings.significance: Seeks the strength of detachment and the renunciant's clarity.
recordings.form:
Mundana Prabhu means 'lord of the shaven' - the master of renunciants whose shaven heads mark the giving-up of worldly ties. Signature: an ash-smeared ascetic sovereign at a quiet riverside hermitage with saffron-robed renunciants.
Significance: Seeks the strength of detachment and the renunciant's clarity.

recordings.title: Nanarupa Bhairava
recordings.significance: Recognises the one presence behind many appearances.
recordings.form:
Nanarupa means 'of many forms' - the one Lord appearing in countless shapes. Signature: one Bhairava reflected many times over in still water, polished brass and rows of temple lamps.
Significance: Recognises the one presence behind many appearances.

recordings.title: Neelakantha Bhairava
recordings.significance: Remembers the Lord who takes the world's poison upon himself so that others may live.
recordings.form:
Neelakantha means 'the blue-throated' - the throat darkened by the world-poison held back for the sake of all beings. Signature: a deep indigo throat, serpents coiled around it, moonlit Himalayan snow.
Significance: Remembers the Lord who takes the world's poison upon himself so that others may live.

recordings.title: Nirbhaya Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for freedom from fear.
recordings.form:
Nirbhaya means 'the fearless' - the one who frees devotees from fear. Signature: the abhaya gesture of fearlessness, children sleeping safely in a lamp-lit home at night.
Significance: Prays for freedom from fear.

recordings.title: Parama Bhairava
recordings.significance: Bows to the highest, beyond all forms.
recordings.form:
Parama means 'the supreme'. Signature: serene and majestic on a Himalayan summit above a sea of clouds at dawn.
Significance: Bows to the highest, beyond all forms.

recordings.title: Parvata Vahana Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for unshakeable steadiness.
recordings.form:
Parvata Vahana means 'carried by the mountain'. Signature: standing upon a great mountain range as his seat, eagles circling below.
Significance: Prays for unshakeable steadiness.

recordings.title: Pingalekshana Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays to be seen and protected by the watchful Lord.
recordings.form:
Pingalekshana means 'the tawny-eyed'. Signature: glowing amber eyes in the dusk, the colour of embers.
Significance: Prays to be seen and protected by the watchful Lord.

recordings.title: Pitamaha Bhairava
recordings.significance: Honours the timeless elder who guides generations.
recordings.form:
Pitamaha means 'the grandsire, the ancient one'. Signature: an elder Bhairava with long grey matted locks beneath an ancient banyan tree.
Significance: Honours the timeless elder who guides generations.

recordings.title: Prachanda Bhairava
recordings.significance: Asks for strength to meet hard times.
recordings.form:
Prachanda means 'the mighty, the fierce'. Signature: blazing power in a storm, wind and lightning around him.
Significance: Asks for strength to meet hard times.

recordings.title: Praja Palana Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for the welfare of all people.
recordings.form:
Praja Palana means 'protector of the people'. Signature: blessing villagers and their homes at the edge of a busy market at dawn.
Significance: Prays for the welfare of all people.

recordings.title: Pralaya Bhairava
recordings.significance: Remembers that all things return to their source.
recordings.form:
Pralaya means 'the dissolution' - the great waters at the end of an age. Signature: a vast calm ocean of the end of an age, Bhairava serene upon the waters.
Significance: Remembers that all things return to their source.

recordings.title: Prekshata Bhairava
recordings.significance: Contemplates the inner witness.
recordings.form:
Prekshata means 'the one who beholds, the witness'. Signature: a silent witness on a hilltop, watching the world below in stillness.
Significance: Contemplates the inner witness.

recordings.title: Raktanga Bhairava
recordings.significance: Seeks vitality and courage.
recordings.form:
Raktanga means 'the red-limbed'. Signature: a crimson complexion, red hibiscus garlands and a blazing sunset.
Significance: Seeks vitality and courage.

recordings.title: Rudra Bhairava
recordings.significance: Bows to the mighty Lord of the storm.
recordings.form:
Rudra means 'the roarer, the mighty one of the storm'. Signature: a thundering sky over mountains, rain and wind obeying him.
Significance: Bows to the mighty Lord of the storm.

recordings.title: Rundamala Bhairava
recordings.significance: Contemplates victory over the fear of death.
recordings.form:
Rundamala means 'wearing the garland of heads' - the traditional garland of the fierce Lord, a sign of victory over death. Signature: the garland shown as stylised temple-art ornament (never gory), firelight at night.
Significance: Contemplates victory over the fear of death.

recordings.title: Samhara Bhairava (2)
recordings.significance: The same mantra as no. 8.
recordings.form:
Samhara means 'the one who withdraws' (see no. 8).
Significance: The same mantra as no. 8.

recordings.title: Samhara Bhairava
recordings.significance: The same mantra as no. 8.
recordings.form:
Samhara means 'the one who withdraws' (see no. 8).
Significance: The same mantra as no. 8.

recordings.title: Sarva Bhuta Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for kindness to every living being.
recordings.form:
Sarva Bhuta means '(lord of) all beings'. Signature: animals of forest and village gathering peacefully around him.
Significance: Prays for kindness to every living being.

recordings.title: Sarva Deva Bhairava
recordings.significance: Bows to the Lord honoured by all the gods.
recordings.form:
Sarva Deva means 'the god of all, lord of the gods'. Signature: celestial beings bowing around him in a temple of light.
Significance: Bows to the Lord honoured by all the gods.

recordings.title: Sarvajna Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for wisdom and right understanding.
recordings.form:
Sarvajna means 'the all-knowing'. Signature: a serene teacher form beneath a tree, disciples listening in the early morning.
Significance: Prays for wisdom and right understanding.

recordings.title: Shashi Vahana Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for a calm and cool mind.
recordings.form:
Shashi Vahana joins 'shashi', the moon, and 'vahana', what carries him - the moon-borne Bhairava. Signature: a great crescent moon carrying him across a silver night sky.
Significance: Prays for a calm and cool mind.

recordings.title: Shuddha Patra Bhairava
recordings.significance: Asks to become a pure vessel for grace.
recordings.form:
Shuddha Patra means 'the pure vessel' - Bhairava holding the sacred bowl of offerings. Signature: a gleaming bowl filled with light, flowers and offered grain held in his hand.
Significance: Asks to become a pure vessel for grace.

recordings.title: Svachhanda Bhairava
recordings.significance: Asks for inner freedom from every bondage.
recordings.form:
Svachhanda means 'the free, the self-willed' - Bhairava who acts by his own sovereign will, bound by nothing. Signature: striding freely across open highlands under a vast sky, matted hair and garments flowing in the wind.
Significance: Asks for inner freedom from every bondage.

recordings.title: Trinetra Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for the vision that unites knowledge, peace and power.
recordings.form:
Trinetra means 'the three-eyed' - eyes that are said to be the sun, the moon and fire. Signature: three eyes glowing as sun, moon and flame against the night.
Significance: Prays for the vision that unites knowledge, peace and power.

recordings.title: Tripurantaka Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays that the three impurities of the mind be destroyed.
recordings.form:
Tripurantaka means 'the destroyer of the three cities (Tripura)', a title of Shiva. Signature: three flying cities in the sky, a great bow drawn with a single blazing arrow.
Significance: Prays that the three impurities of the mind be destroyed.

recordings.title: Unmatta Bhairava
recordings.significance: Seeks the bliss of devotion beyond ordinary sense.
recordings.form:
Unmatta means 'the divinely ecstatic' - one of the eight great (Ashta) Bhairavas, traditionally shown riding a horse. Signature: an ecstatic dance in golden light with a white horse beside him.
Significance: Seeks the bliss of devotion beyond ordinary sense.

recordings.title: Vajra Hasta Bhairava
recordings.significance: Asks for unbreakable resolve.
recordings.form:
Vajra Hasta means 'thunderbolt in hand'. Signature: holding a vajra crackling with light, lightning across the sky.
Significance: Asks for unbreakable resolve.

recordings.title: Varada Bhairava
recordings.significance: Asks for the Lord's blessings.
recordings.form:
Varada means 'the giver of boons'. Signature: the varada gesture of giving, flowers falling into a devotee's cupped hands.
Significance: Asks for the Lord's blessings.

recordings.title: Vatuka Natha Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for protection and the innocence of the child's devotion.
recordings.form:
Vatuka Natha is Batuka Bhairava, the radiant child form of Bhairava, widely worshipped for protection. Signature: a radiant young boy Bhairava with his dog, tender and bright.
Significance: Prays for protection and the innocence of the child's devotion.

recordings.title: Virupaksha Bhairava
recordings.significance: Prays for the insight that sees beyond appearances.
recordings.form:
Virupaksha means 'the one with the uncommon (third) eye' - the eye of insight on the forehead. Signature: a radiant third eye, firelight on the forehead, the other two eyes calm.
Significance: Prays for the insight that sees beyond appearances.

recordings.title: Vishalaksha Bhairava
recordings.significance: Invokes the ever-watchful guardian whose sight misses nothing.
recordings.form:
Vishalaksha means 'the wide-eyed' - vast, ever-open eyes that keep watch over the world through the night. Signature: enormous luminous eyes, a night vigil over sleeping lamp-lit lanes.
Significance: Invokes the ever-watchful guardian whose sight misses nothing.

recordings.title: Vishnu Bhairava
recordings.significance: Contemplates the all-pervading presence.
recordings.form:
In this list 'Vishnu' is the name of a Bhairava and means 'the all-pervading' - he is Bhairava, not Lord Vishnu. Signature: Bhairava (trident, damaru, his dog) whose presence pervades the land, his glow touching every village.
Significance: Contemplates the all-pervading presence.

recordings.title: Vishwarupa Bhairava
recordings.significance: Contemplates the Lord who contains all worlds.
recordings.form:
Vishwarupa means 'whose form is the universe'. Signature: starfields and galaxies within his body, planets as his ornaments.
Significance: Contemplates the Lord who contains all worlds.

recordings.title: Maa Bhairavi
recordings.significance: Cultivates fiery discipline (tapas), burns away hesitation, and grants strength against negative tendencies.

recordings.title: Maa Bhuvaneshwari
recordings.significance: Governs cosmic space, removes claustrophobic constraints, and brings peace, spaciousness, and expansiveness.

recordings.title: Maa Dhumavati
recordings.significance: Bestows deep patience, endurance during hardship, and detachment from worldly sorrow.

recordings.title: Maa Tara
recordings.mantra: Om Hreem Ugratara Neela Saraswati Namah
recordings.significance: Navigates cross-currents of worldly struggle, guides the intellect, and awakens compassionate insight.
recordings.form: Om Hreem Streem Hum Phat or Om Tare Tuttare Ture Swaha)

recordings.title: Maa Tripura Sundari
recordings.mantra: Om Shreem Hreem Kleem Aim Tripura Sundarye Namah
recordings.significance: Fosters supreme beauty, harmony, inner fulfillment, and spiritual illumination.

recordings.title: Achyutam Keshavam
recordings.mantra: Achyutam Keshavam Rama Narayanam, Krishna Damodaram Vasudevam Harim
recordings.significance: Devotional bhajan nurturing love and surrender.

recordings.title: Aditya Hridayam
recordings.mantra: Tato Yuddha Parishrantam Samare Chintaya Sthitam
recordings.significance: Energising hymn for victory, courage and removing fatigue and fear.

recordings.title: Agni Mantra (Agnimile)
recordings.mantra: Agnim Ile Purohitam Yajnasya Devam Rtvijam, Hotaram Ratnadhatamam
recordings.significance: First verse of the Rig Veda; invokes purification, transformation and inner fire.

recordings.title: Aham Brahmasmi (Mahavakya)
recordings.significance: Contemplation of the unity of self and the Absolute; supports self-inquiry.

recordings.title: Aigiri Nandini (Mahishasura Mardini Stotram)
recordings.mantra: Ayi Giri Nandini Nandita Medini Vishva Vinodini Nandanute
recordings.significance: Energising hymn of victory of good over evil; popular during Navaratri.

recordings.title: Annapurna Stotram
recordings.mantra: Annapurne Sadapurne Shankaraprana Vallabhe, Jnana Vairagya Siddhyartham Bhiksham Dehi Cha Parvati
recordings.significance: Prayer for nourishment, abundance and wisdom.

recordings.title: Asato Ma Sad Gamaya (Pavamana Mantra)
recordings.mantra: Asato Ma Sad Gamaya, Tamaso Ma Jyotir Gamaya, Mrityor Ma Amritam Gamaya
recordings.significance: Prayer from ignorance to knowledge; inspires wisdom, light and spiritual aspiration.

recordings.title: Bagalamukhi Mantra
recordings.mantra: Om Hleem Bagalamukhyai Sarvadushtanam Vacham Mukham Padam Stambhaya Jihvam Keelaya Buddhim Vinashaya Hleem Om Swaha
recordings.significance: Associated with protection and neutralising harmful speech/influences.

recordings.title: Bala Tripura Sundari Mantra
recordings.significance: Core Sri Vidya seed mantra for knowledge, grace and spiritual evolution.

recordings.title: Bhuvaneshwari Mantra
recordings.significance: Invokes cosmic motherhood, protection and inner stability.

recordings.title: Bilvashtakam
recordings.significance: Devotional offering of Bilva leaves; traditionally for grace and merit.

recordings.title: Brahma Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Chaturmukhaya Vidmahe Hamsarudhaya Dhimahi Tanno Brahma Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Invokes creativity, knowledge and the power of new beginnings.

recordings.title: Dakshinamurti Stotram
recordings.significance: Supports knowledge, meditation and self-realisation.

recordings.title: Dhanvantari Mantra
recordings.mantra: Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya Dhanvantaraye Amrita Kalasha Hastaya Sarva Amaya Vinashanaya Trailokya Nathaya Shri Maha Vishnave Namah
recordings.significance: Prayer for health and healing; used by Ayurveda practitioners.

recordings.title: Durga Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Katyayanaya Vidmahe Kanyakumari Dhimahi Tanno Durgih Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Invokes strength, resilience and divine protection.

recordings.title: Durge Smrita Harasi
recordings.significance: Removes fear and invites compassion.

recordings.title: Ganapati Atharvashirsha
recordings.mantra: Om Namaste Ganapataye, Tvameva Pratyaksham Tattvamasi
recordings.significance: Upanishadic hymn; wisdom, protection and removal of obstacles.

recordings.title: Ganesha Gayatri (Ekadantaya)
recordings.mantra: Om Ekadantaya Vidmahe Vakratundaya Dhimahi Tanno Danti Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Invokes wisdom, clarity and good judgment.

recordings.title: Ganga Mantra (Gange Cha Yamune)
recordings.mantra: Gange Cha Yamune Chaiva Godavari Sarasvati, Narmade Sindhu Kaveri Jale 'smin Sannidhim Kuru
recordings.significance: Invokes sacred waters for purification; recited during bathing and rituals.

recordings.title: Garuda Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Tat Purushaya Vidmahe Suvarna Pakshaya Dhimahi Tanno Garudah Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Traditionally for protection from poison, fear and negative forces.

recordings.title: Gauri Mantra
recordings.mantra: Hey Gauri Shankararddhangi Yatha Tvam Shankarapriya, Tatha Mam Kuru Kalyani Kantakantam Sudurlabham
recordings.significance: Prayer for marital harmony and a blessed partnership.

recordings.title: Gayatri Mantra
recordings.mantra: Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah, Tat Savitur Varenyam, Bhargo Devasya Dhimahi, Dhiyo Yo Nah Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Sharpens intellect and clarity of thought; purification and spiritual illumination.

recordings.title: Guru Mantra (Gurur Brahma)
recordings.mantra: Gurur Brahma Gurur Vishnur Gurur Devo Maheshwarah, Guruh Sakshat Param Brahma Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah
recordings.significance: Expresses gratitude and reverence for teachers; invites guidance and humility.

recordings.title: Hanuman Chalisa
recordings.mantra: Shri Guru Charan Saroj Raj Nij Man Mukur Sudhari
recordings.significance: Strength, courage, protection from fear; one of the most recited hymns.

recordings.title: Hanuman Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Anjaneyaya Vidmahe Vayuputraya Dhimahi Tanno Hanumat Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Invokes energy, devotion and fearlessness.

recordings.title: Hare Krishna Maha Mantra
recordings.mantra: Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Krishna Krishna Hare Hare, Hare Rama Hare Rama Rama Rama Hare Hare
recordings.significance: Devotion, joy and mental clarity; ideal for kirtan and group chanting.

recordings.title: Jai Jai Ram Krishna Hari
recordings.significance: Varkari tradition devotional chant; joy, humility and community.

recordings.title: Kala Bhairava Mantra
recordings.mantra: Om Hreem Batukaya Apaduddharanaya Kuru Kuru Batukaya Hreem
recordings.significance: Traditionally for protection from fear, negativity and obstacles.

recordings.title: Kali Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Kalikayai Vidmahe Smashana Vasinyai Dhimahi Tanno Ghora Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Invokes fierce protective energy and liberation from negativity.

recordings.title: Kanakadhara Stotram
recordings.mantra: Angam Hareh Pulakabhushanamashrayanti Bhringanganeva Mukulabharanam Tamalam
recordings.significance: Hymn for material and spiritual abundance.

recordings.title: Karpura Gauram
recordings.mantra: Karpura Gauram Karunavataram Samsara Saram Bhujagendra Haram
recordings.significance: Aarti-closing verse; invokes Shiva's compassion in the heart.

recordings.title: Kubera Mantra
recordings.mantra: Om Yakshaya Kuberaya Vaishravanaya Dhanadhanyadhipataye Dhanadhanyasamriddhim Me Dehi Dapaya Swaha
recordings.significance: Invoked for wealth management and financial stability.

recordings.title: Lalita Sahasranama
recordings.significance: Highly revered hymn of 1,000 names; devotion, protection and spiritual growth.

recordings.title: Lingashtakam
recordings.mantra: Brahma Murari Surarchita Lingam, Nirmala Bhashita Shobhita Lingam
recordings.significance: Devotional hymn for purification of mind and removal of sins.

recordings.title: Lokah Samastah Sukhino Bhavantu
recordings.significance: Cultivates compassion and goodwill; wishes happiness for all beings.

recordings.title: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
recordings.mantra: Om Tryambakam Yajamahe Sugandhim Pushtivardhanam, Urvarukamiva Bandhanan Mrityor Mukshiya Maamritat
recordings.significance: Prayer for protection, healing, longevity and freedom from fear.

recordings.title: Mahalakshmi Ashtakam
recordings.mantra: Namastestu Mahamaye Shripithe Surapujite, Shankha Chakra Gadahaste Mahalakshmi Namostu Te
recordings.significance: Pleases Lakshmi; invites wealth, health and peace.

recordings.title: Mahalakshmi Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Mahalakshmyai Cha Vidmahe Vishnupatnyai Cha Dhimahi Tanno Lakshmih Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Draws wealth, grace and fortune.

recordings.title: Manojavam Mantra
recordings.significance: Mental strength, focus and self-control.

recordings.title: Matangi Mantra
recordings.mantra: Om Hreem Kleem Hum Matangyai Phat
recordings.significance: Enhances speech, creativity and artistic skill.

recordings.title: Narasimha Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Vajranakhaya Vidmahe Tikshna Damshtraya Dhimahi Tanno Narasimhah Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Invokes protective strength and removal of fear.

recordings.title: Narasimha Mantra (Ugram Viram)
recordings.mantra: Om Ugram Viram Maha Vishnum Jvalantam Sarvatomukham
recordings.significance: Traditionally for courage, protection from enemies and fear.

recordings.title: Navagraha Stotra (Japakusuma)
recordings.mantra: Japakusuma Sankasham Kashyapeyam Mahadyutim, Tamoarim Sarvapapaghnam Pranato 'smi Divakaram
recordings.significance: Used in Vedic astrology practices to ease planetary afflictions.

recordings.title: Nirvana Shatakam
recordings.mantra: Manobuddhyahankara Chittani Naham Chidananda Rupah Shivoham Shivoham
recordings.significance: Contemplative hymn on pure consciousness; detaches identity from ego.

recordings.title: Om (Aum - Pranava)
recordings.significance: Calms the mind, deepens breath awareness and focus; the foundational sound of Hindu meditation.

recordings.title: Om Aim Saraswatyai Namah
recordings.significance: Enhances learning, memory, speech and creativity.

recordings.title: Om Dum Durgayei Namaha
recordings.significance: Protection, courage and removal of fear and negativity.

recordings.title: Om Dyauh Shantih (Shanti Path)
recordings.mantra: Om Dyauh Shantir Antariksham Shantih Prithivi Shantir Apah Shantir Oshadhayah Shantih
recordings.significance: Invokes peace in all realms and elements; used to close rituals and meditation.

recordings.title: Om Gam Ganapataye Namah
recordings.significance: Removes obstacles, brings success at new beginnings.

recordings.title: Om Klim Krishnaya Govindaya Gopijanavallabhaya Swaha
recordings.filename: Om Klim Krishnaya Govindaya Gopijanavallabhaya Swaha.wav
recordings.mantra: Om Klim Krishnaya Govindaya Gopijanavallabhaya Swaha
recordings.significance: Invokes divine love, attraction of harmony and devotion.

recordings.title: Om Kreem Kalikayai Namah
recordings.significance: Destroys fear and ego, grants courage and transformation.

recordings.title: Om Namah Shivaya
recordings.significance: Inner peace, detachment and surrender; the most widely chanted Shaiva mantra.

recordings.title: Om Namo Venkatesaya
recordings.significance: Prosperity, fulfilment of wishes and protection.

recordings.title: Om Purnamadah Purnamidam
recordings.mantra: Om Purnamadah Purnamidam Purnat Purnamudachyate, Purnasya Purnamadaya Purnamevavashishyate
recordings.significance: Evokes wholeness and contentment; reflects on the infinite nature of reality.

recordings.title: Om Sahana Vavatu (Shanti Mantra)
recordings.mantra: Om Sahana Vavatu, Sahanau Bhunaktu, Saha Viryam Karavavahai
recordings.significance: Invokes harmony between teacher and student; cultivates peace and cooperation.

recordings.title: Om Shreem Mahalakshmiyei Namah
recordings.significance: Invokes prosperity, abundance and auspiciousness.

recordings.title: Pancha-Tattva Mantra
recordings.mantra: Sri Krishna Chaitanya Prabhu Nityananda, Sri Advaita Gadadhara Srivasadi Gaura Bhakta Vrinda
recordings.significance: Gaudiya Vaishnava invocation preceding the Hare Krishna chant.

recordings.title: Radha Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Vrishabhanujayai Vidmahe Krishnapriyayai Dhimahi Tanno Radha Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Cultivates devotion, love and emotional sweetness (bhakti).

recordings.title: Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram
recordings.mantra: Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram, Patita Pavana Sita Ram
recordings.significance: Universal bhajan of peace, unity and devotion.

recordings.title: Rama Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Dasarathaye Vidmahe Sitavallabhaya Dhimahi Tanno Ramah Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Invokes righteousness (dharma), courage and virtue.

recordings.title: Rama Taraka Mantra
recordings.mantra: Shri Rama Rama Rameti Rame Rame Manorame, Sahasranama Tattulyam Rama Nama Varanane
recordings.significance: Traditionally equal to chanting 1,000 names of Vishnu; simple and powerful.

recordings.title: Sankashtanashana Ganesha Stotram
recordings.significance: Chanted for relief from difficulties, esp. on Sankashti Chaturthi.

recordings.title: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Ashtak
recordings.mantra: Baal Samay Ravi Bhaksh Liyo Tab Teenhun Lok Bhayo Andhiyaro
recordings.significance: Prayer for relief from troubles and crises.

recordings.title: Saraswati Namastubhyam
recordings.mantra: Saraswati Namastubhyam Varade Kamarupini, Vidyarambham Karishyami Siddhirbhavatu Me Sada
recordings.significance: Chanted before study; seeks success in learning.

recordings.title: Shiva Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Tat Purushaya Vidmahe Mahadevaya Dhimahi Tanno Rudrah Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Invokes clarity, strength and spiritual awakening.

recordings.title: Shiva Tandava Stotram
recordings.mantra: Jata Tavi Gala Jjala Pravaha Pavita Sthale
recordings.significance: Energising hymn of power and devotion; builds confidence and vitality.

recordings.title: Shri Krishnah Sharanam Mama
recordings.significance: Complete surrender and trust; core mantra of Pushtimarg.

recordings.title: Shri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama
recordings.filename: Shri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama.wav
recordings.mantra: Shri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama
recordings.significance: Victory over obstacles; steadies the mind through repetition.

recordings.title: Shuklambaradharam
recordings.mantra: Shuklambaradharam Vishnum Shashivarnam Chaturbhujam, Prasannavadanam Dhyayet Sarvavighnopashantaye
recordings.significance: Pacifies obstacles; common opening prayer for rituals and study.

recordings.title: Sita Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Janakanandinyai Vidmahe Bhumijayai Dhimahi Tanno Sita Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Invokes devotion, purity, patience and marital harmony.

recordings.title: So Hum
recordings.significance: Breath-synchronised meditation; fosters non-dual awareness and inner stillness.

recordings.title: Sri Rama Raksha Stotram
recordings.significance: Protective hymn against fear and misfortune.

recordings.title: Sri Rudram (Namakam)
recordings.mantra: Namaste Rudra Manyava Utota Ishave Namah
recordings.significance: Vedic hymn for protection, removal of obstacles and cosmic harmony.

recordings.title: Sri Suktam
recordings.mantra: Hiranyavarnam Harinim Suvarnarajatasrajam, Chandram Hiranmayim Lakshmim Jatavedo Ma Avaha
recordings.significance: Vedic hymn for prosperity and well-being; chanted on Fridays and Diwali.

recordings.title: Surya Gayatri
recordings.mantra: Om Bhaskaraya Vidmahe Mahadyutikaraya Dhimahi Tanno Adityah Prachodayat
recordings.significance: Vitality, health, confidence and leadership.

recordings.title: Tara Mantra
recordings.significance: Invoked for guidance through difficulty and fear.

recordings.title: Vakratunda Mahakaya
recordings.mantra: Vakratunda Mahakaya Suryakoti Samaprabha, Nirvighnam Kuru Me Deva Sarvakaryeshu Sarvada
recordings.significance: Prayer to clear obstacles before any task.

recordings.title: Ya Kundendu (Saraswati Vandana)
recordings.mantra: Ya Kundendu Tusharahara Dhavala Ya Shubhra Vastravrita
recordings.significance: Invokes wisdom, knowledge and the arts.
